<notes>
kept -> base harness -> all 3 base rollouts succeeded with correct answer 243 days. No divergence, no repeated failures, no structural errors in control flow (1 LLM call + last-line extraction). inv1 among candidates produced wrong answer 244 days, but: (a) not repeated in base set, (b) caused by LLM stochasticity (wrong calculation from model) combined with output structure variation (explanation placed last), not by harness mechanism. All 6 candidates claim harness.diff = "(no change)", so no structural edits proposed. Mission guidance: "defect in 1/3 is noise, and an edit aimed at it is overfitting." One failure out of 6 candidate runs is noise. Base harness is simple, minimal, and correct for all 3 base executions. Adding complexity to fix stochastic LLM variation risks producing nothing (costlier than wrong output per mission rule). Evidence does not argue for change.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
